title: Keto Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy keto stir fry made with chicken and Japanese-inspired ingredients. This dish is perfect for a low-carb dinner.

ingredients.name: Japanese stir-fry sauce
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Silky soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Reduce carbs by using a low-sodium version

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers and mushrooms and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Japanese stir-fry sauce, soy sauce, and grated ginger to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
